title: Light ají de gallina (chicken in ají sauce) with rice and egg
steps: Poach the chicken in salted water for 15 minutes and shred it, keeping 200 ml of the stock. Cook the rice and boil the eggs for 9 minutes.
Soak the bread in the milk and blend smoothly with the walnuts, Parmesan and ají paste.
Chop the onion and garlic, soften in the oil for 6 minutes and add the turmeric.
Stir in the bread cream and enough stock for a creamy sauce, add the chicken, heat for 5 minutes and season with salt.
Serve with rice, halved eggs and olives.
